mapper.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kb_document_chunk ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, state INT NOT NULL, tiny_i8 SMALLINT NOT NULL, small_i16 SMALLINT NOT NULL, big_i64 BIGINT NOT NULL, u8_val INT NOT NULL, u16_val INT NOT NULL, u32_val BIGINT NOT NULL, u64_val BIGINT NOT NULL, nullable_int INT NULL, f32_val REAL NOT NULL, f64_val DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, flag BOOLEAN NOT NULL, letter CHAR(1) NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, varchar_val VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, score DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, dec_val NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL, payload BYTEA NOT NULL, event_date DATE NOT NULL, event_time TIME NOT NULL, event_ts TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, json_val JSON NOT NULL, jsonb_val JSONB NOT NULL );
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO kb_document_chunk( state, tiny_i8, small_i16, big_i64, u8_val, u16_val, u32_val, u64_val, nullable_int, f32_val, f64_val, flag, letter, name, varchar_val, enabled, score, dec_val, payload, event_date, event_time, event_ts, json_val, jsonb_val ) VALUES
( #{item.state}, #{item.tiny_i8}, #{item.small_i16}, #{item.big_i64}, #{item.u8_val}, #{item.u16_val}, #{item.u32_val}, #{item.u64_val}, #{item.nullable_int}, #{item.f32_val}, #{item.f64_val}, #{item.flag}, #{item.letter}, #{item.name}, #{item.varchar_val}, #{item.enabled}, #{item.score}, #{item.dec_val}::numeric, decode(#{item.payload}, 'hex'), #{item.event_date}::date, #{item.event_time}::time, #{item.event_ts}::timestamp, #{item.json_val}::json, #{item.jsonb_val}::jsonb )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as failedCount FROM kb_document_chunk;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_document_chunk WHERE nullable_int IS NULL;
